items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I had Snooky, Snooky Young... It was a good band.

ctx.x: Because I had -- let's see, who did I have on there? I had Snooky, Snooky Young, Ernie Royal, Bill Berry, Tony Studd, Frank Wess, Jerome Richardson, Jimmy Hamilton. Who else? Oh, Milt Hinton, Hank Jones. It was a good band. And Johnny Hodges playing first on it, you know. So I came in with the -- you know how you go in shops and buy little trinket things, where they have little quotations on there, and I just came and hung it on the -- I had it hanging on this thing, I think. I'm not sure. Well, where everybody…
